A &) Read about a high-tech solution to traveling “green.” What problem did it solve?

Bicycles are being parked in a whole new way in
Tokyo. Commuters used to leave their bicycles on the
sidewalks outside train stations, but people couldn’t
move around them and something clearly had to be
done. Now, at Kasai Station, commuters can leave
their bikes in a 10-level underground parking garage
that is controlled by robots. Robots store nearly
10,000 bicycles a day. When commuters want their
bicycles, they use cards to identify them. Within sec-
onds, a robot finds and brings it to them. The Tokyo
garage is so successful that more “green” garages are
being considered.
